# Chemotaxis III manuscript

> Public manuscript and reproducibility materials for "Chemotaxis models with signal-dependent sensitivity and a logistic-type source, III: Bifurcation and spike-like solutions" (Le Chen, Ian Ruau, Wenxian Shen). The source here is the October 20, 2026 v2 candidate; the published preprint is arXiv:2610.20976v1.

Claim boundaries:
- This repository does not assert an arXiv v2 upload, journal submission, or acceptance; arXiv v1 and this candidate are not claimed identical.
- The Lean companion distinguishes 47 verified scopes, 23 conditional scopes, and 3 exclusions across 73 overlapping manuscript-facing scopes. These are not percentages of whole-paper correctness. The whole paper is not Lean-certified.
- Manuscript and figures remain copyright their authors; no additional manuscript license is granted.

## Manuscript

- [10-20-2026-CRS-3-Le-v2.tex](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/chemotaxis-paper-iii/main/10-20-2026-CRS-3-Le-v2.tex): LaTeX source; theorems are stated in the Introduction
- [paper-III.bib](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/chemotaxis-paper-iii/main/paper-III.bib): bibliography (amsrefs build)
- [manuscript-manifest.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/chemotaxis-paper-iii/main/manuscript-manifest.json): SHA-256 of every manuscript file
- [build.sh](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/chemotaxis-paper-iii/main/build.sh): LuaLaTeX build with an unresolved-reference check

## Lean companion

- [chemotaxis-paper-iii-lean llms.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/chemotaxis-paper-iii-lean/main/llms.txt): the formalization's own map and claim boundary
- [Documentation site](https://chenle02.github.io/chemotaxis-paper-iii-lean/): what is proved, results by paper section, exact Lean statements

## Optional

- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/chemotaxis-paper-iii/main/README.md): human landing page with the abstract
- [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/chemotaxis-paper-iii/main/CITATION.cff): citation metadata
